name: Claude Meetings
desc: Claude joins video calls as a participant and starts on work
desc_zh: 以参会者身份加入视频会议并当场开工的 Claude
solves: Meetings end with notes nobody acts on; Claude attends the call, then drafts the plans and tasks while you talk.
solves_zh: 会议开完没人跟进纪要，Claude 直接参会，边听边起草计划和任务。
best_for: A stand-up runs long and you want the follow-up tasks written before you are back at your desk.
best_for_zh: 站会开得太久，想回到工位前就拿到整理好的后续任务。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.anthropic.com/news/product and https://claude.com/resources/arti）。 In-product surface inside paid Claude plans; Google Meet supported first.
